Subject: Suspicious exfil alerts — recommended immediate admin offboard (NOT termination confirmation)

Team,

Security flagged repeated large outbound transfers from the account of Priya N. (Senior PM, ID 4472) between 11:30pm–02:20am PDT. We have attached the access log and a screenshot of the alert. Indicators include multiple downloads from a private S3 staging bucket and an unusual pattern of email-to-external-attachments.

Recommended immediate actions (priority order):
- Suspend interactive login and remote access (VPN, Okta session kill) — scope: Priya N. only.
- Preserve device for triage (do not wipe) and collect a disk image where possible.
- Initiate a contained forensic capture (Cindy Park at Forensics Lab is available if we engage).
- Pause any automated payroll or off-cycle payments until HR confirms next steps (Glen at payroll services should be looped).

I understand there may be immigration constraints here (Priya is H-1B sponsored). Before any termination or written notice we should get legal/immigration counsel involved. This is an investigation step; I'm not asking for termination paperwork to be sent yet — just administrative containment and hold on payout until we have clarity.

Logs attached: access-log-20270501-20270502.csv, screenshot-exfil-alert.png

Marcus
Lead, Security Operations

Aisha / team,

We should treat this as an internal investigation with ACLs (access control lists) tightened immediately. A few legal guardrails:

- Do not terminate until we have a documented investigation summary and evidence chain. Immediate suspension of access is defensible for investigative purposes, but written termination triggers different immigration and contract obligations for H-1B — counsel (Eleanor) is copied for quick input.
- Preserve all Slack, Google Drive, Git, and email logs. Marcus, provide an export or link to the investigation ticket (SUP-9123) and a short evidence summary (3–5 bullet points).
- Regarding pay: HR can place funds in escrow pending outcome; any deviation from standard severance should be approved by Legal and Finance. Glen, coordinate manual escrow mechanics if HR requests it.
- Equity and vested RSUs: Do not finalize repurchase or forfeiture actions until Legal confirms clause applicability and timing (contract review required).

If the investigation supports termination for cause we will prepare a narrow termination letter that references a pending investigation and immediate access removal. If not, consider a suspension with paid leave while we complete forensics.

Action items for me: I will review the draft termination letter and propose edits for risk mitigation. Eleanor, can you advise on H-1B notification/recordkeeping timelines and whether we need to pause I-9/visa steps?

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Employment & Privacy
